end_finality: Not freshly verified by this agent; root must inspect latest complete day and preliminary labels. If changed, shift every window together and retain Oct24 baseline separately.
search_type_target: Web: text-based; preserve the actual UI label and do not silently merge different search types.
all_device_note: ALL includes tablet; do not label MOBILE+DESKTOP as ALL.
date_basis: GSC daily reporting dates, not Dubai calendar days; record displayed timezone/date definitions.

collection_approach.query_page_daily: After every exact-query Pages capture, preserve each actual returned page. For priority/competing pairs, keep exact Query+Exact Page+UAE+Device, export Dates for90d; separate per-pair series is required for daily ownership.
collection_approach.global_context: Optional exact-query ALL-country datasets must be explicitly labeled and kept separate from UAE.
